text:
marta: Heads-up: we just got a burn-rate alert for token-level latency on /v1/chat (us-west). p99 token-latency jumped ~3x and burn_rate metric crossed 1.2. Paging window 5m.
raj: seeing same. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 74% around 17:02 UTC. correlates with a kernel-selector rollout that landed at 17:00.
kevin: linking dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/seq-latency?org=infra — p50 stable but tail exploded. also bump in average seq length for that route in the last hour.
alin: quick profile shows increased time in attention kernel for long sequences. attaching flame: https://artifacts.redwood/trace/1793456 — seems kernel-v2 picks different matmul path on >1024 tokens.
raj: also noticed batching heuristics started allowing 64ms batch delay under low qps; that increases prefix wait for tiny requests. the combination could widen tail.
marta: deploy-bot, what exactly rolled at 17:00? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: rollout complete: kernel-selector=kernel-v2, batching-window-ms=64 (canary -> 80% traffic), kv-ttl=120s. commit: a1f3d2b
kevin: ok — two immediate mitigations: revert kernel-selector for the canary, or lower batching-window to 16ms for latency-sensitive routes. which do we prefer?
sre-oncall: prefer lowering batching-window first (less risky) and force KV cache warmup for /v1/chat. if burn_rate stays >1.1 for 10m -> pager.
raj: started a patch to reduce batching-window on canary to 16ms and increase kv-ttl to 300s for the route. pushing now.
alin: re: metrics — we should add a derived metric for "token_latency_delta" (token_latency_without_cache - token_latency_with_cache) and surface per-route p99 token delta. current dashboards hide that.
kevin: agree. Prometheus query proposal: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))` and `rate(kv_hits_total[5m]) / rate(kv_requests_total[5m])` for hit rate. add alert rule:
```
- alert: TokenLatencyBurn
  expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > 0.35)
    and on(route) (increase(burn_rate_window[5m]) > 1.1)
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 token latency high for {{ $labels.route }}"
```
raj: rollback is in flight now. I'll monitor KV hit-rate and p99.
marta: thanks. please capture a short postmortem if this stays noisy. add to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-burn
kevin: follow-up items: (1) add token_delta metric (2) make per-route batching config scoped by SLO tags (3) autotune burn-rate windows based on traffic variance.
sre-oncall: updating pager thresholds: set severity=page for sustained burn_rate>1.1 AND p99_token_latency>350ms for 10m. otherwise warn at 5m.
raj: rollback done at 17:08 UTC. initial numbers look better — kv-hit back to 90% and p99 trimmed by ~60%. will keep monitoring until 17:25.
marta: great. assign follow-ups: raj -> postmortem + KV warming job, kevin -> dashboard + alert rule PR, alin -> perf regression test for kernel-v2 on long sequences. I'll update the incident channel once postmortem is up. :thumbsup:
